---
title: "attaviz"
subtitle: "World Bank Group data visualization theme for Altair"
---

`attaviz` turns Altair into a World Bank Group chart factory. Enable the
theme once, and every chart picks up WBG typography, colors, grids, and
mark styling automatically.

```python
import altair as alt
import attaviz

attaviz.enable()

chart = alt.Chart(data).mark_bar().encode(
    x="category:N",
    y="value:Q",
    color="category:N",
)
```
